summary: Confirmed $20/$18 (park page and the county's own 2026 alert), FCFS, April 15-Oct 15. Changed site count 31 -> 27 (21 electric + 6 primitive, per the current park page); added 50-amp, showers, flush toilets, dump, water. Waterfront lead up (12-acre lake). Phone found: 712-744-3403.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, stored not waterfront; stored evidence 'no water body beside them' came from a hazy Esri frame). The park page says the park 'contains a 12 acre lake' (lake, not pond, by size). Clear NAIP imagery shows the campground on a peninsula with a lake arm (weed/algae-covered in the late-summer frame) wrapping its south and east sides. The south-pointing pads (~41.8553,-95.4630) end ~20-30 m from the shoreline across open mowed lawn with scattered trees; the east pads (~41.8558,-95.4620) sit ~15-30 m from the east arm across lawn. A mowed path runs along the shore; there is no road or driveway between, and the picnic shelter/fire ring area is west of those pads rather than in front of them. On the open-apron rule that reads as lakefront for those pads, lakeview at least. Uncertainties: whether that arm is open lake or a weedy marsh/inlet at normal pool, and the bank height. Leaving the value to the waterfront pass.
